new_results.statement_short: For independent Z,V,W, U=u(Z) of cap M_U, V,W of caps M_V,M_W, arbitrary H(Z),eta(Z), the law of H+2 beta U V+gamma W^2+2 eta(Z)W has continuous density bounded by 4 sqrt(2) M_W sqrt(M_U M_V)/sqrt(|beta gamma|).
At an exact-rank-three physical zero-diagonal pivot A_ii=0 with nonzero off-diagonal column, the residual transverse block has rank one and lambda1 lambda2 lambda3=-gamma(beta^2+||d0||^2).
If the canonical light-cone directions u,d0,w have pairwise disjoint original-coordinate supports, exact-rank-three target matrices satisfy ||p_Q||_infinity <=8*2^(3/4)<13.455.
